name: Manganic-Requiem
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a nearby asteroid belt emerge like the bones of the planet.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on solar potential are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
